title: Non-interactive output mode
user_prompt: Make a CLI report useful both in an interactive terminal and when stdin is piped or stdout is redirected to a file. In non-interactive mode, it should print a clear summary and exit without waiting for input or emitting interactive terminal-control sequences. Keep interactive behavior when an actual TTY is available.

acceptance_checks.assertion: The process completes safely with piped stdin and does not require terminal raw mode.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Command and output/exit status with piped stdin.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Redirected stdout contains readable report content and no unintended interactive ANSI/OSC sequences.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Captured redirected output and control-sequence check.

acceptance_checks.assertion: TERM=dumb produces a usable plain-text result without crashing.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Command output and exit status with TERM=dumb.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Interactive mode remains available when the supported TTY conditions are present.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Interactive smoke-test notes or harness output.

hard_gates.failure_condition: A required non-TTY case throws due to raw-mode or TTY-only assumptions.
Interactive cursor/alternate-screen/mouse control sequences leak into ordinary redirected logs.
